capability: volume-averaged Darcy/Brinkman drag closure in a bounded channel

protocol.solver: D2Q9 BGK + zero-sum Guo (2002) forcing, half-way bounce-back walls
protocol.tape: steady state gate on u_bar (relative change per sampling chunk)

ladder.g_scaling: g ~ (64/H)^2 so that Re and Ma stay fixed (self-similar)

controls: drag off (K -> inf) must reproduce the Poiseuille parabola
truncated Guo source (negative control) must show a mass sink
